primary_hypothesis.text: Full ORION reduces false scientific-authority promotion under provenance, checker, evaluator and contamination attacks relative to strong source-aware verification baselines while maintaining clean-case authority coverage within the frozen safety guard.

secondary_hypotheses.text: The safety gain persists when clean supported claims are included, so blocking everything is not competitive.
ORION selects CANNOT_CHECK/BLOCK more accurately when evidence, checker independence or evaluation integrity is genuinely insufficient.

resource_policy: Compared verifiers receive the same evidence packet/retrieval allowance and bounded checker budget. Strong source-aware baselines are not starved of source identity. Security features with unavoidable overhead report the safety/coverage/cost frontier explicitly.
exclusion_policy: No false promotion, false block, abstention, checker failure, evaluator-detected attack or candidate-caused timeout is excluded. Host infrastructure failures may be excluded only under a frozen symmetric rule and remain archived.

statistics.unit: frozen claim/attack case; stochastic checker repeats nested within case/system
statistics.interval: Wilson 95% intervals for false-promotion/coverage/detection rates; paired percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples) for matched differences
statistics.multiplicity: Single primary false-promotion hypothesis with clean-coverage guard; Holm correction for inferential secondary attack-family comparisons
statistics.practical_margin: Design target: at least -0.05 absolute false-authority-promotion rate versus the strongest matched source-aware baseline, with clean authority coverage non-inferior within -0.05 absolute.

access_policy.hidden_labels: Attack family, protected answer/support labels and holdout labels are inaccessible to the candidate and candidate-authored checker.
access_policy.evaluator_custody: Evaluator/holdout and protected attack labels are frozen in independent host custody before candidate runs; candidate cannot write evaluator/guard state.
access_policy.search_contamination_policy: Search-time benchmark answer/metadata exposure is logged prospectively and is itself an evaluated attack coordinate.
access_policy.access_logging: File, patch, evaluator, holdout, network/search and evidence-content accesses are retained for protected review.
